question: Manganiyar aur Langa kis kshetra ke prasiddh lok gayak hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Manganiyar aur Langa Marwar (Barmer-Jaisalmer) ke prasiddh lok gayak samuday hain. | Galat kyun: Mewar Udaipur kshetra hai, Shekhawati Kacchi Ghodi/Chang se, Hadoti Kota-Bundi se juda hai. | Concept: Lok gayak samuday ↔ kshetra. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Manganiyar-Langa = Marwar ke registan ke gayak. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Makrana marble kis liye prasiddh hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Makrana (Nagaur) ka marble Taj Mahal me prayog hua; ise GI Tag mila hai. | Galat kyun: Kota Doria saree hai, Thewa kaanch par sone ki kala hai, Blue Pottery Jaipur ki hai — marble se sambandh nahi. | Concept: Khanij/shilp ↔ uska prasiddh prayog. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Makrana marble = Taj Mahal. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Bharat ka kshetrafal kitna hai aur duniya me sthan kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Bharat ka kshetrafal 32,87,263 sq km hai aur duniya me iska 7th sthan hai. | Galat kyun: Baaki teenon vikalpon me kshetrafal aur sthan donon galat hain. | Concept: Desh ka kshetrafal ↔ vishva me sthan. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 32,87,263 — '32' se shuru, 7th sthan. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 1.

question: Bharat ka standard time kis deshantar par aadharit hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — IST 82°30′ E deshantar par aadharit hai (Mirzapur, UP); IST = GMT + 5:30. | Galat kyun: 77°30′ E Delhi ke paas hai, 72°30′ E aur 87°30′ E Bharat ke manak deshantar nahi hain. | Concept: Manak samay = ek kendriya deshantar se tay hota hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: IST = 82°30′ E, Mirzapur. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 1.

question: Kark Rekha (Tropic of Cancer) kin rajyon se nahi guzarti?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Kark Rekha 8 rajyon se guzarti hai: Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, WB, Tripura, Mizoram — Bihar inme nahi hai. | Galat kyun: Gujarat, Rajasthan aur MP teeno Kark Rekha par hain, isliye ve 'nahi guzarti' ka uttar nahi ho sakte. | Concept: Kark Rekha (23.5°N) ↔ 8 rajya. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 8 rajya — Gujarat se Mizoram tak; Bihar nahi. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 1.

question: Bharat ki sabse unchi choti kaun si hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Bharat ki sabse unchi choti Kangchenjunga (8,586 m) hai; Everest Nepal me hai. | Galat kyun: Everest Bharat ki nahi, Nepal ki choti hai; Anai Mudi Western Ghats ki sabse unchi hai; Nanda Devi Uttarakhand ki unchi choti hai, lekin Kangchenjunga se chhoti. | Concept: Desh ki sabse unchi choti ≠ duniya ki sabse unchi choti. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Kangchenjunga = Bharat ki chhat (8,586 m); Everest = Nepal. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 2.

question: Godavari nadi ko kya kaha jata hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Godavari ko 'Dakshin Ganga' kaha jata hai; yah dakshin Bharat ki sabse lambi pra-dweepiya nadi hai. | Galat kyun: 'Ganga ki beti', 'Pashchim Ganga' aur 'Uttar Ganga' Godavari ke upnaam nahi hain. | Concept: Nadi ↔ upnaam ↔ kshetra. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Godavari = Dakshin ki Ganga. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 3.

question: Kaun si nadiyan purab se pashchim ki ore behti hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Narmada aur Tapti purab se pashchim behti hain (rift valley se) aur Arabian Sea me girti hain. | Galat kyun: Kaveri, Mahanadi, Godavari, Krishna, Ganga aur Yamuna pashchim se purab behkar Bay of Bengal me girti hain. | Concept: Rift valley wali nadiyan ulta behti hain — purab se pashchim. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Narmada-Tapti = ulta behna (rift valley). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 3.

question: Bharat me sabse zyada varsha kahan hoti hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Mawsynram (Meghalaya) me Bharat me sabse zyada varsha hoti hai; Cherrapunji bhi paas me hai. | Galat kyun: Shimla, Ooty aur Darjeeling pahadi sthan hain, lekin varsha me Mawsynram se bahut peeche hain. | Concept: Varsha = mansoon + pahadi dhalaan (orographic rainfall). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Mawsynram = sabse zyada varsha (Meghalaya). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 4.

question: Kali mitti (Regur) kis fasal ke liye upyukt hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Kali mitti (Regur, Deccan) kapas ke liye sabse upyukt hai; isme nami rokne ki kshamata hoti hai. | Galat kyun: Ganna aur chawal jalodh mitti me, gehun jalodh/kali donon me hota hai — lekin kapas ke liye kali mitti sabse prasiddh hai. | Concept: Mitti ↔ fasal ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Kali mitti = kapas (Regur = Deccan). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 10 Geography Ch. 1.

question: Hari Kranti ke janak kaun mane jate hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Bharat me Hari Kranti ke janak M.S. Swaminathan mane jate hain (1960s, gehu-chawal, Punjab-Haryana-UP). | Galat kyun: C.V. Raman bhautiki (Raman effect), Hargobind Khorana jeev-vigyan, Verghese Kurien Shwet Kranti (doodh) se jude hain. | Concept: Kranti ↔ uske janak. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Hari Kranti = Swaminathan; Shwet Kranti = Kurien. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 10 Geography Ch. 4.

question: Bharat ka sabse lamba National Highway kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — NH-44 (Srinagar–Kanyakumari, ~3,745 km) Bharat ka sabse lamba National Highway hai. | Galat kyun: NH-19, NH-27 aur NH-48 lambe rajmark hain, lekin NH-44 se chhote hain. | Concept: Sabse lamba NH = desh ke uttar se dakshin tak. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: NH-44 = Srinagar se Kanyakumari (poora desh). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NHAI.

question: Bharat me pehli rail kab aur kahan chali?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Bharat me pehli rail 1853 me Mumbai se Thane ke beech chali. | Galat kyun: 1857, 1860 aur 1850 galat varsh hain; Delhi–Kolkata aur Chennai–Bengaluru pehli rail ke marg nahi the. | Concept: Pehli rail ↔ varsh ↔ marg. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 1853 = Mumbai–Thane (pehli rail). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 10 Geography Ch. 7.

question: Jharkhand ka Jharia kis khanij ke liye prasiddh hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Jharkhand ka Jharia Bharat ka sabse bada koyla kshetra hai. | Galat kyun: Loha, petroleum aur bauxite Jharia ki pehchan nahi hain. | Concept: Khanij kshetra ↔ khanij. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Jharia = koyla (Jharkhand). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 10 Geography Ch. 5.

question: Census 2011 ke anusar Bharat ki jansankhya kitni thi?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Census 2011 ke anusar Bharat ki jansankhya 121.08 crore thi; sex ratio 943 aur saksharta 73% thi. | Galat kyun: 102.8 crore 2001 ka aankda hai; 130.5 aur 115.2 crore 2011 ke nahi hain. | Concept: Census 2011 hi abhi tak ka aakhri pura census hai (2021 deferred). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 121.08 crore — 2011. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; Census of India 2011.

question: Census 2011 ke anusar Bharat ka sex ratio kitna tha?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Census 2011 me Bharat ka sex ratio 943 tha (prati 1,000 purush par 943 mahilayein). | Galat kyun: 933 (2001 ka), 940 aur 927 galat aankde hain. | Concept: Sex ratio = prati 1,000 purush par mahilayein. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 943 — 2011. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; Census of India 2011.

question: Bharat me kitne Rajya aur Kendrashasit Pradesh hain (2026)?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — 2026 tak Bharat me 28 Rajya aur 8 Kendrashasit Pradesh hain. | Galat kyun: 27/9, 30/6 aur 29/7 purane ya galat vibhajan hain (J&K punargathan 2019 ke baad 28/8). | Concept: Rajya/UT ki sankhya samay ke saath badalti hai — vartaman sankhya yaad rakho. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 28 + 8 = 36 (2026). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md.

question: Western Ghats ki sabse unchi choti kaun si hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Anai Mudi (2,695 m) Western Ghats ki sabse unchi choti hai. | Galat kyun: Doddabetta Nilgiri ki sabse unchi choti hai (Western Ghats ki nahi); Nilgiri ek shrinkhala hai, choti nahi; Mahabaleshwar ek sthan hai. | Concept: Shrinkhala ↔ uski sabse unchi choti. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Anai Mudi = Western Ghats ki chhat; Doddabetta = Nilgiri ki chhat. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 2.

question: Brahmaputra nadi ka udgam kahan hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Brahmaputra ka udgam Mansarovar (Tibet) ke paas hai. | Galat kyun: Amarkantak Narmada ka, Yamunotri Yamuna ka, Gangotri Ganga ka udgam hai. | Concept: Nadi ↔ udgam. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Brahmaputra = Tibet (Mansarovar) se aati hai. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 3.

question: Bharat ka ekmatra bada marusthal kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Thar Marusthal (Rajasthan) Bharat ka ekmatra bada marusthal hai. | Galat kyun: Gobi (Mongolia/China), Sahara (Africa) Bharat me nahi hain; Kutch rann hai, marusthal nahi. | Concept: Marusthal ↔ desh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Thar = Bharat ka ekmatra marusthal. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 2.

question: Digboi kis liye prasiddh hai?
option_a: Bharat ki sabse purani tel refinery
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Digboi (Assam) Bharat ki sabse purani tel refinery/kshetra hai. | Galat kyun: Digboi bandargah, koyla kshetra ya bandh nahi hai. | Concept: Sabse purana ↔ kshetra. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Digboi = Assam ka tel (sabse purana). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 10 Geography Ch. 5.

question: PM-KISAN ke tahat kisan ko varsh me kitni rashi milti hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — PM-KISAN (2019) ke tahat kisan ko ₹6,000/varsh milte hain. | Galat kyun: ₹12,000, ₹4,000 aur ₹8,000 yojana ki rashi nahi hain. | Concept: Yojana ↔ rashi ↔ varsh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: PM-KISAN = 6,000/varsh (2019). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; pmkisan.gov.in.

question: Rajasthan ka kshetrafal kitna hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Rajasthan ka kshetrafal 3,42,239 sq km hai — Bharat ka sabse bada rajya (~10.4%). | Galat kyun: Baaki teenon vikalpon me aankda galat hai (4,42,239; 3,22,239; 2,42,239). | Concept: Rajya ka kshetrafal ↔ desh me sthan. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 3,42,239 — sabse bada rajya. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography.

question: Rajasthan ki sabse unchi choti kaun si hai aur unchai kitni?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Guru Shikhar (Mount Abu, Sirohi) 1,722 m — Rajasthan ki sabse unchi choti. | Galat kyun: Taragarh aur Kumbhalgarh ki unchai 1,722 m nahi hai; 'Abu 1,200 m' sabse unchi choti nahi hai. | Concept: Rajya ki sabse unchi choti ↔ unchai ↔ sthan. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Guru Shikhar = 1,722 m (Mount Abu). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Aravalli parvat shrinkhala kis disha me faili hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Aravalli parvat shrinkhala Uttar-Purab se Dakshin-Pashchim disha me faili hai; yah duniya ki sabse purani shrinkhalaon me se ek hai. | Galat kyun: Uttar–Dakshin, Dakshin-Purab–Uttar-Pashchim aur Purab–Pashchim Aravalli ki disha nahi hain. | Concept: Shrinkhala ki disha = uske failaav ki disha. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Aravalli = NE–SW (Delhi se Gujarat tak). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Rajasthan ki sabse lambi nadi kaun si hai jo keval Rajasthan me behti hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Banas keval Rajasthan me behne wali sabse lambi nadi hai (Rajsamand se Tonk); ise 'Van ki Asha' kaha jata hai. | Galat kyun: Chambal Rajasthan ki sabse badi nadi hai lekin MP se aati hai; Mahi aur Luni chhoti hain aur rajya se bahar bhi behti hain. | Concept: 'Keval Rajasthan me' = poori nadi ek hi rajya me. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Banas = sirf Rajasthan ki nadi (Rajsamand–Tonk). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Chambal nadi par kaun se bandh hain?
option_a: Gandhi Sagar, Rana Pratap Sagar, Jawahar Sagar
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Chambal par Gandhi Sagar, Rana Pratap Sagar aur Jawahar Sagar bandh hain. | Galat kyun: Mahi Bajaj Sagar Mahi par hai; Pong aur Bhakra Beas/Sutlej par hain; Bisalpur Banas par aur Jaisamand ek jheel hai. | Concept: Nadi ↔ uspar bane bandh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Chambal = Gandhi, Rana Pratap, Jawahar Sagar (teen bandh). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Bharat ki sabse badi khare pani ki jheel kaun si hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Sambhar Jheel Bharat ki sabse badi khare pani ki jheel hai; yahan namak utpadan hota hai. | Galat kyun: Nakki, Pichola aur Pushkar meethi pani ki jheelein hain aur chhoti hain. | Concept: Jheel ↔ pani ka prakar (khara/meetha) ↔ aakar. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Sambhar = sabse badi khari jheel = namak. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Udaipur ko kis naam se jana jata hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Udaipur 'Jheelon ka Shahar' hai (Pichola, Fatehsagar, Udaisagar). | Galat kyun: Jaipur Gulabi Nagari, Jodhpur Neela Shahar hai; 'Sunehra Shahar' Jaisalmer se juda hai. | Concept: Shahar ↔ upnaam. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Udaipur = jheelein; Jaipur = gulabi; Jodhpur = neela; Jaisalmer = sunehra. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Rajasthan ka rajya vriksh kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Khejri Rajasthan ka rajya vriksh hai; Rohida rajya pushp hai. | Galat kyun: Rohida rajya pushp hai (vriksh nahi); Peepal aur Bargad Rajasthan ke rajya chinh nahi hain. | Concept: Rajya chinh (vriksh/pushp/pakshi/pashu) alag-alag hote hain. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Khejri = vriksh; Rohida = pushp. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Rajasthan ka rajya pakshi kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Godawan (Great Indian Bustard) Rajasthan ka rajya pakshi hai. | Galat kyun: Unt rajya pashu hai, Chinkara rajya pashu ke roop me ullekhit hota hai, Mor Bharat ka rashtriya pakshi hai. | Concept: Rajya pakshi ≠ rajya pashu ≠ rashtriya pakshi. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Godawan = rajya pakshi; Mor = rashtriya pakshi. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Ranthambore National Park kahan hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Ranthambore National Park Sawai Madhopur me hai. | Galat kyun: Sariska Alwar me, Keoladeo Bharatpur me, Desert NP Jaisalmer me hai. | Concept: Rashtriya udyan ↔ jila. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Ranthambore = Sawai Madhopur (baagh); Sariska = Alwar; Keoladeo = Bharatpur (pakshi). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Keoladeo National Park kis liye prasiddh hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Keoladeo (Bharatpur) pakshiyon ke liye prasiddh hai — Siberian crane jaise pravasi pakshi yahan aate the; yah UNESCO World Heritage (1982) hai. | Galat kyun: Unt, bagh aur hiran Keoladeo ki pehchan nahi hain (bagh Ranthambore se juda hai). | Concept: Udyan ↔ uski visheshta. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Keoladeo = Bharatpur ke pakshi (UNESCO 1982). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Rajasthan me sabse zyada varsha kahan hoti hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Rajasthan me varsha paschim se purab badhti hai; Jhalawar (~100 cm) me sabse zyada aur Barmer (~10 cm) me sabse kam varsha hoti hai. | Galat kyun: Barmer, Bikaner aur Jaisalmer paschimi shushk kshetra me hain — varsha wahan sabse kam hoti hai. | Concept: Varsha ka gradient — paschim (kam) se purab (zyada). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Varsha = paschim se purab badhti hai (Barmer 10 cm → Jhalawar 100 cm). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Thar marusthal Rajasthan ke kitne kshetra ko gherta hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Thar marusthal Rajasthan ke lagbhag 60% kshetra ko gherta hai; yah duniya ka sabse ghana aabadi wala marusthal hai. | Galat kyun: 75%, 50% aur 40% galat anumaan hain. | Concept: Marusthal ka vistar = rajya ka hissa. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Thar = ~60% (lagbhag aadhe se zyada). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Indira Gandhi Nahar ka udgam kahan se hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Indira Gandhi Nahar Harike Barrage (Punjab) se nikalti hai — Rajasthan ki sabse badi nahar pariyojana. | Galat kyun: Bhakra Sutlej par, Bisalpur Banas par, Gandhi Sagar Chambal par hai — IGNP ka udgam inme se koi nahi. | Concept: Nahar ↔ udgam sthal. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: IGNP = Harike Barrage (Punjab) se. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Zawar (Udaipur) kis khanij ke liye prasiddh hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Zawar (Udaipur) Bharat me zinc-lead ka sabse bada kshetra hai. | Galat kyun: Bauxite, loha aur koyla Zawar ki pehchan nahi hain. | Concept: Khanij kshetra ↔ khanij. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Zawar = Zinc-Lead (Udaipur). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Bhadla Solar Park kahan hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Bhadla Solar Park Jodhpur jile me hai — duniya ke sabse bade solar parkon me se ek. | Galat kyun: Barmer, Jaisalmer aur Bikaner me bhi solar pariyojanayein hain, lekin Bhadla Jodhpur me hai. | Concept: Urja pariyojana ↔ jila. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Bhadla = Jodhpur (solar). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Rajasthan kis fasal ke utpadan me Bharat me No.1 hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Rajasthan Bajra aur Sarso ke utpadan me Bharat me No.1 hai. | Galat kyun: Makka-Jowar, Gehun-Chawal aur Ganna-Kapas me Rajasthan No.1 nahi hai. | Concept: Fasal ↔ utpadan me sthan. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Bajra + Sarso = Rajasthan No.1. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Census 2011 ke anusar Rajasthan ki jansankhya ghantva (density) kitna tha?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Census 2011 me Rajasthan ki jansankhya ghantva 200/sq km tha (Bharat: 382). | Galat kyun: 150, 250 aur 382 galat hain — 382 Bharat ka aankda hai, Rajasthan ka nahi. | Concept: Ghantva = jansankhya / kshetrafal. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Rajasthan 200, Bharat 382 (2011). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md; Census of India 2011.

question: Pakistan se Rajasthan ki seema kitni lambi hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Rajasthan ki Pakistan se antarrashtriya seema lagbhag 1,070 km hai. | Galat kyun: 800, 500 aur 1,500 km galat anumaan hain. | Concept: Antarrashtriya seema ki lambai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Pakistan seema = ~1,070 km. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Jaisamand jheel kis naam se bhi jani jati hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Jaisamand jheel ko Dhebar Jheel bhi kaha jata hai; yah ek kritrim jheel hai. | Galat kyun: Rajsamand, Fatehsagar aur Pichola alag jheelein hain. | Concept: Jheel ↔ uska dusra naam. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Jaisamand = Dhebar Jheel. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Luni nadi kahan vilin hoti hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Luni antarvahini nadi hai — Rann of Kutch me vilin hoti hai, samudra me nahi girti. | Galat kyun: Bay of Bengal aur Arabian Sea me girne wali nadiyan samudra tak pahunchti hain; Luni Yamuna me nahi milti. | Concept: Antarvahini nadi = samudra tak nahi pahunchti. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Luni = andar hi khatm (Rann of Kutch). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 3.

question: Barmer me kaun sa tel kshetra prasiddh hai?

question: Bharat ka Samvidhan kab lagoo hua?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Samvidhan 26 Nov 1949 ko apnaya gaya aur 26 Jan 1950 ko lagoo hua; isiliye 26 Jan ko Republic Day manate hain. | Galat kyun: 26 Nov 1949 apnane ki tareekh hai, lagoo hone ki nahi; 15 Aug 1947 swatantrata hai; 26 Jan 1949 galat varsh hai. | Concept: Apnana (adopt) aur lagoo hona (enforce) alag hain. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 26 Nov apnaya, 26 Jan lagoo — ek hi tareekh (26), alag kaam. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: Samvidhan ki Drafting Committee ke adhyaksh kaun the?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Drafting Committee ke adhyaksh Dr B.R. question: 42nd Amendment (1976) se Prastavana me kaun se shabd jode gaye?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank

question: Anuchhed 32 ko kisne 'Samvidhan ki aatma' kaha?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Dr B.R. Ambedkar ne Anuchhed 32 ko 'Samvidhan ki aatma' kaha, kyunki yah Fundamental Rights ko lagu karane ka adhikar deta hai. | Galat kyun: Gandhi, Nehru, Patel ne yah upma nahi di. | Concept: Art 32 — Samvaidhanik Upchar ka Adhikar (Supreme Court me seedhe jane ka adhikar). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Art 32 = aatma; bina iske adhikar kagaz par hi reh jate. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: Matdan ki aayu 21 se 18 varsh kab ki gayi?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank

question: GST kis amendment se lagoo hua?

question: Panchayati Raj ka udghatan Bharat me pehli baar kahan hua?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank

question: 73rd Amendment kis se sambandhit hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — 73rd Amendment (1992) ne Panchayati Raj ko samvaidhanik darja diya (11th Schedule, 29 vishay). | Galat kyun: 74th Nagarpalika se hai; mahila aarakshan aur GST alag vishay hain. | Concept: 73rd = gaon (Panchayat), 74th = shahar (Nagarpalika). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 73 gaon, 74 shahar. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: Panchayati Raj ki 3-tier vyavastha me beech ka star kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — 3-tier vyavastha: Gram Panchayat (gaon) → Panchayat Samiti (block, beech) → Zila Parishad (zila). | Galat kyun: Gram Panchayat sabse neeche hai; Zila Parishad sabse upar; Gram Sabha koi star nahi, gaon ke sabhi matdataon ki sabha hai. | Concept: Neeche se upar: gaon → block → zila. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: G-P-Z: Gaon, Panchayat Samiti, Zila. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md.

question: Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957) ne kis ki sifarish ki?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957) ne 3-tier Panchayati Raj ki sifarish ki. | Galat kyun: 2-tier ki sifarish Ashok Mehta Committee (1977) ne ki thi; GST aur mahila aarakshan is samiti se nahi jude. | Concept: Balwant Rai Mehta = 3-tier; Ashok Mehta = 2-tier. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Balwant = 3, Ashok = 2. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: Rajasthan High Court ki mukhya peeth kahan hai?

question: Anuchhed 21 kis adhikar se sambandhit hai?
option_d: Jeevan aur vyaktigat swatantrata ka adhikar

question: Fundamental Duties kis amendment se jode gaye?

question: Sampatti ka adhikar Fundamental Right se kab hataya gaya?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — 44th Amendment (1978) se sampatti ka adhikar Fundamental Right se hatakar kanuni adhikar (Art 300A) bana. | Galat kyun: 42nd ne Duties jode; 52nd dal-badal se hai; 61st matdan aayu se. | Concept: Sampatti ab FR nahi, kanuni adhikar hai — isliye is par Art 32 lagu nahi hota. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 44th ne sampatti ko FR se bahar kiya. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: Nari Shakti Vandan (mahila aarakshan) kis amendment se hai?

question: Bal ka SI unit kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Bal ka SI unit Newton (N) hai; F = m × a se unit kg·m/s² banta hai. | Galat kyun: Pascal dabav ka, Joule karya/urja ka, Watt shakti ka unit hai. | Concept: Har bhautik rashi ka apna SI unit hota hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: F=ma → Newton; W=Fs → Joule; P=W/t → Watt. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Force and Laws of Motion).

question: Ohm's Law kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Ohm's Law: V = IR (Voltage = Current × Resistance). | Galat kyun: V = I/R ulta hai; F = ma Newton ka dusra niyam hai; P = VI shakti ka sutra hai (sahi sutra, galat sawal). | Concept: Sthir tapman par V ∝ I hota hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: VIR — V = I × R. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 11 (Electricity).

question: Prakash ki gati vacuum me kitni hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Prakash ki gati vacuum me 3 × 10^8 m/s hai — brahmand ki sabse tez gati. | Galat kyun: 10^5 aur 10^6 ghataank galat hain; 10^10 bahut zyada hai. | Concept: Prakash ko chalne ke liye madhyam nahi chahiye. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 3-8 — 3 × 10^8. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 9 (Light).

question: Myopia (nikat drishti) ko kis lens se sudhara jata hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Myopia (nikat drishti) me door ki vastu dhundhli dikhti hai kyunki image retina se pehle banti hai; avtal (concave) lens prakash ko failakar image ko retina par lata hai. | Galat kyun: Uttal (convex) lens Hypermetropia ke liye hai; cylindrical lens astigmatism ke liye; bifocal dono dosh ke liye. | Concept: Lens prakash ko modkar image ki jagah badalta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Myopia = Minus (concave) lens. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 10 (Human Eye).

question: Akash neela kyun dikhai deta hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Akash neela prakash ke prakirnan (scattering) ke karan dikhta hai: neele rang ki tarangdairdhya sabse chhoti hoti hai, isliye vah sabse zyada bikharta hai. | Galat kyun: Vivartan (diffraction), prativartan (reflection) aur apvartan (refraction) alag ghatnayen hain. | Concept: Rayleigh scattering — bikhrao ∝ 1/λ⁴. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Neela sabse chhota, sabse zyada bikharta. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 10.

question: Dhvani ki gati hawa me lagbhag kitni hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Dhvani ki gati hawa me ~343 m/s (20°C par) hai; vacuum me dhvani bilkul nahi chalti kyunki use madhyam chahiye. | Galat kyun: 1,500 m/s pani me dhvani ki gati ke aas-paas hai; 3 × 10^8 m/s prakash ki gati hai; 150 m/s galat hai. | Concept: Dhvani ki gati madhyam par nirbhar karti hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Hawa 343, pani ~1500, prakash 3×10^8. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Sound).

question: Bharat me ghar ki bijli ka voltage aur frequency kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Bharat me ghar ki bijli 220 V, 50 Hz AC hai. | Galat kyun: 110 V / 60 Hz America ka manak hai; 220 V / 60 Hz aur 110 V / 50 Hz kisi bade desh ka ghar-manak nahi. | Concept: Har desh ka voltage-frequency manak alag hota hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Bharat 220-50; America 110-60. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 12; standard GK.

question: 1 HP kitne watt ke barabar hai?

question: Archimedes ka siddhant kis se sambandhit hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Archimedes ka siddhant utplavan (buoyancy) se hai: utplavan bal = visthapit drav ka bhar. | Galat kyun: Prakash, gati aur dabav se iska seedha sambandh nahi. | Concept: Dubi vastu par drav upar ki or bal lagata hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Archimedes — nahate samay 'Eureka'; visthapit pani = utplavan. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Gravitation).

question: Newton ka dusra niyam kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Newton ka dusra niyam: F = ma (bal = dravyaman × twaran). | Galat kyun: Jadta pehla niyam hai; kriya-pratikriya teesra niyam hai; gurutvakarshan alag niyam hai. | Concept: Bal twaran paida karta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Pehla jadta, dusra F=ma, teesra kriya-pratikriya. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Laws of Motion).

question: Shreni (series) me jude do pratirodh 4 ohm aur 6 ohm ka kul pratirodh kitna hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Series me kul pratirodh judta hai: R = R1 + R2 = 4 + 6 = 10 ohm. | Galat kyun: 2.4 ohm parallel ka uttar hai (1/R = 1/4 + 1/6); 6 aur 24 ohm ganana ki galti hain. | Concept: Series me pratirodh badhta hai; parallel me kam hota hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Series = seedha jod; Parallel = ulta jod. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 11.

question: Ek vastu 20 m/s se chal rahi hai; 5 sec me kitni doori tay karegi?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Doori = gati × samay = 20 × 5 = 100 m. | Galat kyun: 50 m (20 × 2.5) aur 25 m galat guna hain; 4 m (20 ÷ 5) bhag hai, guna nahi. | Concept: v = s/t, isliye s = v × t. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Doori = gati × samay — guna karo, bhag nahi. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Motion).

question: Samanya namak (common salt) ka rasayanik sutra kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Samanya namak = NaCl (Sodium chloride). | Galat kyun: NaHCO3 baking soda hai; Na2CO3 washing soda hai; CaO quick lime (bina bujha chuna) hai. | Concept: Aam naam ↔ rasayanik sutra ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Namak NaCl; khane wala soda NaHCO3; dhone wala soda Na2CO3. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 2 (Acids, Bases and Salts).

question: Baking soda ka rasayanik sutra kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Baking soda = NaHCO3 (Sodium bicarbonate). | Galat kyun: NaCl namak hai; CaSO4.1/2H2O Plaster of Paris hai; Ca(OH)2 bujha hua chuna (slaked lime) hai. | Concept: Aam naam ↔ rasayanik sutra ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Baking = Bicarbonate (donon 'B'). | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 2.

question: Shuddh pani ka pH kitna hota hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Shuddh pani ka pH 7 (neutral) hota hai; <7 acid, >7 base. | Galat kyun: 0 sabse acidic, 14 sabse basic hai; 5 halka acidic hai. | Concept: pH scale 0–14 par chalta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 7 = neutral; 7 se neeche acid, upar base. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 2.

question: Hawa me Nitrogen ki matra kitni hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Hawa me Nitrogen ~78% aur Oxygen ~21% hoti hai (baaki ~1% argon, CO2 aadi). | Galat kyun: 21% oxygen ki matra hai; 50% aur 1% galat hain. | Concept: Hawa mishran hai, ek gas nahi. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 78-21-1 — Nitrogen, Oxygen, baaki. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Atmosphere).

question: Sirke (vinegar) me kaun sa acid hota hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Sirke (vinegar) me Acetic acid hota hai. | Galat kyun: Sulphuric acid gandhak ka tezab hai; Citric acid nimbu me hota hai; Hydrochloric acid pet me banta hai. | Concept: Khane ki cheez ↔ uska acid. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Sirka = Acetic; Nimbu = Citric. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 2.

question: LPG me mukhya roop se kaun si gas hoti hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — LPG me mukhya roop se Butane + Propane hoti hai. | Galat kyun: Hydrogen jalne wali gas hai, LPG me nahi; CO2 aag bujhane wali hai; Methane CNG me hota hai. | Concept: LPG = Liquefied Petroleum Gas. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: LPG = Butane+Propane; CNG = Methane. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 4 (Carbon and its Compounds).

question: Lohe par jang (rust) ka rasayanik sutra kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Jang = Fe2O3.xH2O (hydrated ferric oxide); jang lagne ke liye hawa + nami dono chahiye. | Galat kyun: FeO ferrous oxide hai; FeS iron sulphide hai; Fe3O4 magnetite hai. | Concept: Lohe ka oxidation + pani = jang. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Jang = Fe2O3.xH2O; rokne ke liye zinc ki parat (galvanisation). | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 3 (Metals and Non-metals).

question: Parmanu sankhya (Atomic number) kya hoti hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Parmanu sankhya (Z) = Proton ki sankhya; yahi element ki pehchan hai. | Galat kyun: Proton + Neutron = Mass number (A) hai; Neutron akela ya Electron + Neutron ka koi matlab nahi. | Concept: Z element tay karta hai; A uska bhar. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Z = Proton; A = Proton+Neutron. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Structure of the Atom).

question: Koshika ka 'powerhouse' kise kaha jata hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Mitochondria ko 'powerhouse' kaha jata hai kyunki yahan shwasan se ATP (urja) banti hai. | Galat kyun: Nucleus niyantran karta hai (brain); Chloroplast photosynthesis karta hai (sirf paudhon me); Lysosome pachan karta hai (suicide bag). | Concept: Har koshikang ka apna kaam hota hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Mitochondria = powerhouse; Nucleus = brain; Chloroplast = kitchen. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Fundamental Unit of Life).

question: Prakash sanshleshan (photosynthesis) me kaun si gas nikalti hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Photosynthesis: 6CO2 + 6H2O → C6H12O6 + 6O2; Oxygen bahar nikalti hai, CO2 andar jati hai. | Galat kyun: CO2 andar jati hai, bahar nahi; Nitrogen aur Hydrogen is prakriya me nahi nikalte. | Concept: Paudhe khana banate hain aur oxygen dete hain. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Paudhe CO2 lete hain, O2 dete hain. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 5 (Life Processes).

question: Universal donor blood group kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Blood group O universal donor hai: O par koi antigen nahi hota, isliye kisi ka plasma use attack nahi karta. | Galat kyun: AB universal recipient hai; A aur B sirf apne group (aur AB) ko de sakte hain. | Concept: Antigen na ho to koi attack nahi. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Sample chapter — 'O khali hai, isliye sabka hai'. | Source: samples/sample_07_science_blood_groups.md.

question: Universal recipient blood group kaun sa hai?

explanation: Sahi: C — AB universal recipient hai: AB ke plasma me koi antibody nahi hota, isliye vah sabhi group se le sakta hai. | Galat kyun: O sirf O se le sakta hai; A aur B seemit group se le sakte hain. | Concept: Antibody na ho to koi rok nahi. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Sample chapter — 'AB bhara hai, isliye sab le sakta hai'. | Source: samples/sample_07_science_blood_groups.md.

question: Vayask manav me kul kitni haddiyan hoti hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Vayask manav me 206 haddiyan hoti hain; bacche me ~300 hoti hain (umar ke saath jud jati hain). | Galat kyun: 300 bacche ki sankhya hai; 216 aur 196 galat hain. | Concept: Haddiyan umar ke saath judti hain. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 206 — vayask; sabse badi Femur, sabse chhoti Stapes. | Source: NCERT Biology (Human Skeleton); standard reference.

question: Manav hriday me kitne kaksh hote hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Hriday me 4 kaksh hote hain (2 atria + 2 ventricles); samanya heartbeat ~72/min, BP 120/80 mmHg. | Galat kyun: 2, 3 ya 5 kaksh galat hain. | Concept: Dayein hissa ashuddh khoon, bayein hissa shuddh khoon sambhalta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 4 kaksh — 2 upar (atria), 2 neeche (ventricles). | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 5.

question: Vitamin C ki kami se kaun sa rog hota hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Vitamin C ki kami se Scurvy hota hai. | Galat kyun: Rickets Vitamin D se, Beriberi Vitamin B1 se, Night blindness Vitamin A se hota hai. | Concept: Vitamin ↔ kami-rog ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: C = Scurvy; D = Rickets; B1 = Beriberi; A = Night blindness. | Source: NCERT Class 10/11 (Nutrition).

question: Insulin kis granthi se banta hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Insulin Pancreas (Agnashay) ki beta cells se banta hai; iski kami se Diabetes hota hai. | Galat kyun: Pituitary master gland hai; Adrenal adrenaline deti hai; Thyroid thyroxine deti hai. | Concept: Granthi ↔ hormone ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Insulin = Pancreas; Diabetes = Insulin ki kami. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 7 (Control and Coordination).

question: Malaria kis ke dwara failta hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Malaria Plasmodium (protozoa) se hota hai aur Anopheles mada machhar se failta hai. | Galat kyun: Aedes dengue failata hai; housefly haija failata hai; bacteria se nahi, protozoa se hota hai. | Concept: Rog ↔ karak ↔ vahak ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Malaria = Anopheles; Dengue = Aedes. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Why Do We Fall Ill).

question: TB (Tuberculosis) kis se hota hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — TB Mycobacterium tuberculosis (bacteria) se hota hai; BCG tika lagta hai. | Galat kyun: Virus (flu), fungus (daadh), protozoa (malaria) — TB inme se kisi se nahi hota. | Concept: Rog ↔ karak ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: TB = Bacteria; BCG = TB ka tika. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science.

question: Chechak (smallpox) ka tika kisne khoja?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Edward Jenner ne 1796 me chechak (smallpox) ka tika khoja. | Galat kyun: Pasteur ne rabies ka tika diya; Salk ne polio ka; Fleming ne penicillin khoji. | Concept: Khoj ↔ vyakti ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Jenner = chechak (1796); Pasteur = rabies. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science.

question: Project Tiger kab shuru hua?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Project Tiger 1973 me shuru hua; pehla National Park Jim Corbett (1936) hai. | Galat kyun: 1982 Keoladeo ko UNESCO sthal milne ka varsh hai; 1970 aur 1975 galat hain. | Concept: Paryavaran karyakram ↔ varsh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Project Tiger 1973 — baagh bachao. | Source: Standard GK / NCERT Class 10 (Environment).

question: World Environment Day kab manaya jata hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — World Environment Day 5 June ko manaya jata hai. | Galat kyun: 22 April Earth Day hai; 16 Sep Ozone Day hai; 21 June Yoga Day hai. | Concept: Mahatvapurna din ↔ tareekh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 5 June = Paryavaran; 22 April = Prithvi. | Source: Standard GK.

question: Greenhouse gas kaun si nahi hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Oxygen (O2) greenhouse gas nahi hai; CO2, CH4 aur N2O greenhouse gases hain. | Galat kyun: N2O, CH4 aur CO2 teeno garmi ko rokte hain. | Concept: Greenhouse gas = infrared vikiran ko rokne wali gas. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: CO2, CH4, N2O — greenhouse; O2 nahi. | Source: NCERT Class 9/10 (Environment).

question: Chipko Andolan kis se sambandhit hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Chipko Andolan (1973, Sunderlal Bahuguna, Uttarakhand) pedon ki raksha ke liye tha — log pedon se chipak gaye the. | Galat kyun: Jal sanrakshan, van jeev aur mitti sanrakshan is andolan ka seedha lakshya nahi the. | Concept: Andolan ↔ uska lakshya. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Chipko = chipakna (ped se). | Source: NCERT Class 10 (Environment).

question: Master gland kise kaha jata hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Pituitary ko master gland kaha jata hai kyunki vah dusri granthiyon ko niyantrit karti hai. | Galat kyun: Adrenal emergency hormone deti hai; Thyroid metabolism niyantrit karti hai; Pancreas insulin deta hai. | Concept: Granthi ↔ uska kaam. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Pituitary = master gland; Pancreas = insulin. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 7.

question: 240 ka 15% kitna hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — 240 ka 15% = 240 × 15/100 = 36. Shortcut: 10% = 24, 5% = 12, yog = 36. | Galat kyun: A (24) sirf 10% hai; C (30) 12.5% hota hai aur D (48) 20% hota hai — donon galat hisse hain. | Concept: x% of y = (x/100) × y; 10% nikalna sabse aasan tareeka hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 10% = ÷10, 5% = uska aadha — 15% = 10% + 5%. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A2; NCERT Class 8 Mathematics Ch. 8.

question: Ek vastu ka CP Rs 800 aur SP Rs 920 hai. Labh % kitna hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Labh = 920 − 800 = ₹120; Labh% = 120/800 × 100 = 15%. Labh% hamesha CP par nikalte hain, SP par nahi. | Galat kyun: A (20%) 120/600 se banta hai — galat aadhar; B (12%) aur D (10%) bina ganana ke anumaan hain. | Concept: Labh% = (Labh/CP) × 100. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Labh% ka aadhar hamesha CP — 'CP par labh'. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A3.

question: Rs 10,000 par 10% varshik dar se 2 saal ka sadharan byaj kitna hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — SI = P×R×T/100 = 10000 × 10 × 2 / 100 = ₹2,000. Sadharan byaj me har saal ek hi byaj milta hai (₹1,000/saal). | Galat kyun: A (₹2,100) chakravriddhi byaj (CI) hai — SI nahi; C (₹1,000) sirf ek saal ka byaj hai; D (₹1,500) kisi hisse se nahi banta. | Concept: SI = PRT/100 — byaj har saal mooldhan par hi lagta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: SI = 'seedha' byaj — har saal barabar. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A4.

question: Rs 10,000 par 10% se 2 saal ka CI aur SI ka antar kitna hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — 2 saal ke liye CI − SI = P(R/100)² = 10000 × (10/100)² = 10000 × 0.01 = ₹100. Check: CI = ₹2,100, SI = ₹2,000, antar = ₹100. | Galat kyun: A (₹200) antar ka doguna hai; B (₹50) aadha hai; C (₹0) tab hota jab CI = SI hota — dusre saal byaj par bhi byaj milta hai, isliye antar kabhi 0 nahi. | Concept: Dusre saal byaj par byaj milta hai — yahi CI aur SI ka antar hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 2 saal ka antar = P × (R/100)² — seedha sutra. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A4.

question: 5 sankhyaon ka ausat 27 hai. Pehli 4 ka ausat 25 hai. 5th sankhya kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Kul yog = 5 × 27 = 135; pehli 4 ka yog = 4 × 25 = 100; 5th sankhya = 135 − 100 = 35. | Galat kyun: A (30) aur C (27) ausat ke aas-paas ke anumaan hain; B (32) 135 − 103 se banta hai — pehli 4 ka yog 100 hai, 103 nahi. | Concept: Ausat = Yog/Sankhya, isliye Yog = Ausat × Sankhya. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Pehle kul yog nikalo, phir ghatao — ausat se seedha ghatao mat. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A5.

question: A 10 din me aur B 15 din me kaam karta hai. Dono milkar kitne din me karenge?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — A ek din me 1/10 kaam, B 1/15 kaam karta hai; dono milkar ek din me 1/10 + 1/15 = 3/30 + 2/30 = 5/30 = 1/6 kaam karte hain, isliye kul samay = 6 din. | Galat kyun: A (12 din) 10 aur 15 ka ausat hai — samay ka ausat nahi nikalte; C (5 din) aur D (7.5 din) galat jod se bante hain. | Concept: Kaam ki dar (rate) judti hai, din nahi — pehle 1 din ka kaam nikalo. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Rate jodo, din nahi — 1/10 + 1/15 = 1/6. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A6.

question: 72 km/h kitne m/s ke barabar hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — km/h ko m/s me badalne ke liye 5/18 se guna karte hain: 72 × 5/18 = 4 × 5 = 20 m/s. | Galat kyun: A (72 m/s) bina badle wahi sankhya hai; B (18 m/s) 5/18 ko ulta lagane se banta hai; D (25 m/s) galat guna hai. | Concept: 1 km = 1000 m, 1 ghanta = 3600 sec, isliye km/h → m/s = ×1000/3600 = ×5/18. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: km/h → m/s = ×5/18; ulta (m/s → km/h) = ×18/5. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A6.

question: Vritt ki trijya 7 cm hai. Kshetrafal kitna hai? (pi = 22/7)
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Vritt ka kshetrafal = πr² = 22/7 × 7² = 22/7 × 49 = 22 × 7 = 154 cm². | Galat kyun: B (44 cm²) paridhi hai (2πr = 44 cm), kshetrafal nahi; A (164) aur C (144) galat ganana hain. | Concept: Kshetrafal = πr²; paridhi = 2πr — donon alag hain. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: r = 7 ho to πr² me 7 kat jata hai — 22 × 7 = 154. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A7.

question: Ghan (cube) ki bhuja 5 cm hai. Aayatan kitna hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Ghan ka aayatan = a³ = 5³ = 5 × 5 × 5 = 125 cm³. | Galat kyun: C (25 cm³) a² hai — ek satah ka kshetrafal, aayatan nahi; A (100) aur D (150) galat guna hain. | Concept: Aayatan = lambaai × chaudaai × unchai; ghan me teeno barabar (a³). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Aayatan me teen baar guna — 5×5×5. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A7.

question: 12 aur 18 ka LCM (laghutam samapvartya) kitna hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — 12 = 2×2×3, 18 = 2×3×3; LCM = 2×2×3×3 = 36 (dono se vibhajya sabse chhoti sankhya). | Galat kyun: B (72) LCM ka doguna hai — vibhajya to hai, laghutam nahi; C (6) HCF hai, LCM nahi; D (54) 18 se vibhajya hai par 12 se nahi. | Concept: LCM = dono sankhyaon se vibhajya sabse chhoti sankhya. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: LCM ≥ badi sankhya; HCF ≤ chhoti sankhya. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A8.

question: A:B = 3:5 hai aur kul yog 64 hai. B ka maan kitna hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Kul bhaag = 3 + 5 = 8; 8 bhaag = 64, to 1 bhaag = 8; B = 5 × 8 = 40. | Galat kyun: A (24) A ka maan hai (3 × 8); C (32) aur D (48) kul ko galat baantne se bante hain. | Concept: Anupat me pehle kul bhaag nikalo, phir ek bhaag ka maan. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Kul bhaag = 8, ek bhaag = 64 ÷ 8 = 8. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A8.

question: Kul 720 students me 25% Science ke hain. Science students kitne hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — 720 × 25/100 = 720 ÷ 4 = 180 students. | Galat kyun: A (120) aur B (150) bina hisaab ke anumaan hain; C (200) 25% se zyada hota. | Concept: 25% = 1/4 — kul ko 4 se bhag do. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 25% matlab chaunthai — 720 ÷ 4 = 180. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A9.

question: Ek sankhya me 20% vriddhi phir 20% kami hoti hai. Net parivartan kitna hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — 100 → +20% = 120 → −20% = 120 − 24 = 96, net −4%. Sutra: a + b + ab/100 = 20 − 20 − (20×20/100) = −4%. | Galat kyun: B (+4%) chinh ki galti hai — kami vriddhi se zyada hoti hai kyunki dusri baar aadhar bada hota hai; D (0%) tab hota jab dono ek hi sankhya par lagte; C (−2%) galat sutra se banta hai. | Concept: Kramik % me dusra badlav pehle badle hue maan par lagta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Barabar % badhao-ghatao = hamesha ghata — a²/100%. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A2.

question: CP Rs 1,200 par 10% hani ho to SP kitna hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — 10% hani ka matlab SP = CP ka 90% = 1200 × 0.9 = ₹1,080. | Galat kyun: B (₹1,100) 1200 − 100 hai — 10% ka matlab ₹100 nahi, ₹120 hai; C (₹1,020) 15% hani hoti; D (₹1,320) 10% labh hota. | Concept: Hani% bhi CP par nikalte hain; SP = CP × (1 − hani%/100). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 10% hani = 90% bacha — seedha ×0.9. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A3.

question: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ... agla pad kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Antar dekho: 6−2=4, 12−6=6, 20−12=8, 30−20=10 — antar har baar 2 badh raha hai, agla antar 12; 30 + 12 = 42. | Galat kyun: A (40) aur C (36) antar ke pattern ko aadha dekhne se bante hain; D (48) agla antar 18 maan le to banta hai. | Concept: Series me pehle antar nikalo, phir antar ka pattern. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Antar likho — 4, 6, 8, 10, 12… | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B2.

question: 252 = 2^2 x 3^2 x 7 hai. 252 ke gunankhandon me 7 ki ghat kitni hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — 252 = 2² × 3² × 7¹, isliye 7 ki ghat (exponent) 1 hai. | Galat kyun: B (3) aur C (2) 2 aur 3 ki ghaatein hain, 7 ki nahi; D (0) tab hota jab 7 gunankhand me hi na ho. | Concept: Abhajya gunankhand (prime factorisation) me har abhajya ki ghat alag hoti hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Ghat = upar likhi chhoti sankhya — 7¹ me 1. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A1.

question: Train 300 m lambi hai, gati 20 m/s hai. Ek khambe ko paar karne me kitna samay lagega?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Khambe ko paar karne me train ko apni lambaai tay karni hoti hai: Samay = Doori/Gati = 300/20 = 15 sec. | Galat kyun: A (10 sec) 300/30 se banta hai — gati 30 nahi hai; B (30 sec) 300/10 se banta hai; D (20 sec) gati ko samay samajhne ki galti hai. | Concept: Khamba (point) paar karne me keval train ki lambaai ginate hain; platform paar karne me train + platform. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Khamba = sirf train; platform = train + platform. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A6.

question: Ek belan (cylinder) ki trijya 7 cm aur unchai 10 cm hai. Aayatan kitna hai? (pi = 22/7)
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Belan ka aayatan = πr²h = 22/7 × 7² × 10 = 22/7 × 49 × 10 = 22 × 7 × 10 = 1540 cm³. | Galat kyun: B (770) aadha aayatan hai; C (3080) doguna hai; D (440) vakr satah (2πrh = 440 cm²) hai, aayatan nahi. | Concept: Aayatan = aadhar ka kshetrafal × unchai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: πr²h — pehle πr² (154), phir ×10. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A8.

question: Ek aayat ki lambaai 12 cm aur chaudaai 8 cm hai. Kshetrafal kitna hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Aayat ka kshetrafal = lambaai × chaudaai = 12 × 8 = 96 cm². | Galat kyun: A (40 cm²) parimap hai (2×(12+8) = 40 cm), kshetrafal nahi; C (20 cm²) lambaai + chaudaai hai; D (80 cm²) galat guna hai. | Concept: Kshetrafal = l × b; parimap = 2(l + b) — donon alag. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Kshetrafal = guna; parimap = jod (×2). | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A7.

question: Pita putra se 3 guna bada hai. 10 saal baad pita putra se 2 guna hoga. Pita ki vartaman aayu kitni hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Putra = x, pita = 3x; 10 saal baad: 3x + 10 = 2(x + 10) → 3x + 10 = 2x + 20 → x = 10; pita = 3 × 10 = 30 varsh. Check: 10 saal baad pita 40, putra 20 — 40 = 2 × 20 ✓. | Galat kyun: A (20) putra ki 10-saal-baad ki aayu hai; C (25) aur D (40) bina samikaran ke anumaan hain — 40 pita ki 10 saal baad ki aayu hai. | Concept: Aayu ke sawal me 'vartaman' ko x mano, dono taraf ek saath saal jodo. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Dono ki aayu me ek saath 10 jodo — sirf ek ki nahi. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A5.

question: HCF x LCM = ? (do sankhyaon ke liye)
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Do sankhyaon ke liye HCF × LCM = sankhyaon ka gunafal. (Jaise 12, 18: HCF 6 × LCM 36 = 216 = 12 × 18 ✓.) | Galat kyun: A (bhag), B (yog) aur C (antar) ka is sutra se koi sambandh nahi. | Concept: HCF × LCM = gunafal — sirf do sankhyaon ke liye. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: HCF × LCM = a × b — ek line ka sutra. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A1.

question: Ek sankhya 3 se vibhajya hai yadi...
option_c: Ankon ka yog 3 se vibhajya ho
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Sankhya 3 se vibhajya hai yadi uske ankon ka yog 3 se vibhajya ho (jaise 252: 2+5+2 = 9, 9 ÷ 3 = 3 ✓). | Galat kyun: A (ant me 0 ya 5) 5 se vibhajyata hai; B (ant me 0) 10 se vibhajyata hai; D (ant me sam ank) 2 se vibhajyata hai. | Concept: Har vibhajyata ka apna niyam — 3 ke liye ankon ka yog. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 3 aur 9 = ankon ka yog; 2 aur 5 = antim ank. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A1.

question: Ek varg (square) ki bhuja 9 cm hai. Parimap kitna hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Varg ka parimap = 4a = 4 × 9 = 36 cm. | Galat kyun: C (81 cm²) kshetrafal hai (a² = 81), parimap nahi; B (18) aur D (27) galat guna hain (2a aur 3a). | Concept: Parimap = chaaron bhujaon ka yog = 4a; kshetrafal = a². | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Parimap = chaaron taraf — 4 × bhuja. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A7.

question: Rs 500 se Rs 650 hone par vriddhi % kitni hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Vriddhi = 650 − 500 = ₹150; vriddhi% = 150/500 × 100 = 30%. | Galat kyun: A (15%) aadha hai; C (20%) 100/500 se banta hai — vriddhi 100 nahi, 150 hai; D (25%) 125/500 se banta hai. | Concept: Vriddhi% ka aadhar hamesha mool (pehla) maan hota hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Badhotri% = (badhotri/mool) × 100. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A2.

question: CAT = 24 hai (C=3, A=1, T=20 ka yog). DOG ka man kya hoga?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — A=1…Z=26 se: D=4, O=15, G=7; yog = 4 + 15 + 7 = 26. CAT = 3+1+20 = 24 iska udaharan tha. | Galat kyun: A (30) aur B (28) galat yog hain; C (24) CAT ka maan hai, DOG ka nahi. | Concept: Coding me pehle aksharon ke sthan (A=1…Z=26) likho, phir yog karo. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: A=1, Z=26 — akshar ko number me badlo. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B1.

question: Yadi CAT = DBU hai (pratyek akshar +1), to DOG kya hoga?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Har akshar +1: D→E, O→P, G→H; DOG = EPH. | Galat kyun: A (EOH) O ko +1 nahi karta; B (DPH) D ko +1 nahi karta; D (FQI) +2 ka pattern hai. | Concept: Letter shifting — har akshar par wahi niyam lagta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Ek akshar check karo, phir sab par lagao. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B1.

question: Shrinkhala: A, C, F, J, O, ... agla akshar kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Aksharon ke sthan: A(1), C(3), F(6), J(10), O(15); antar: +2, +3, +4, +5; agla +6 → O + 6 = 21 = U. | Galat kyun: B (S) aur D (T) antar ko +4/+5 par rokne se bante hain; C (R) galat ginati hai. | Concept: Letter series me antar ko number me badal kar dekho. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Antar likho — 2, 3, 4, 5, 6… | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B2.

question: Shrinkhala: 3, 9, 27, 81, ... agla pad kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Har pad ×3 hai: 3, 9, 27, 81; agla = 81 × 3 = 243. | Galat kyun: A (216) 6³ hai — pattern se nahi banta; C (108) 81 + 27 hai — yog ka pattern nahi; D (162) 81 × 2 hai. | Concept: Pehle antar dekho, phir guna-bhag ka pattern. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 3, 9, 27, 81 — teeno guna. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B2.

question: Shrinkhala: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ... agla pad kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Ye varg sankhyaein hain: 1², 2², 3², 4², 5²; agla 6² = 36. | Galat kyun: A (30) aur C (32) varg nahi hain; D (49) 7² hai — 6² chhoot gaya. | Concept: Varg shrinkhala: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49… | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Varg yaad rakho — 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B2.

question: Ram ne ek ladki ki taraf ishara karke kaha — 'woh meri maa ki ikloti beti ki beti hai.' Ladki Ram ki kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Maa ki ikloti beti = Ram ki behen; uski beti = Ram ki bhanji. | Galat kyun: A (bhatiji) bhai ki beti hoti hai; B (beti) Ram ki apni beti hoti — sawal me behen ki beti hai; C (behen) woh ladki nahi, uski maa hai. | Concept: Blood relation me pehle 'kis ki' ko pehchano, phir rishta jodo. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 'Maa ki ikloti beti' = behen; behen ki beti = bhanji. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B3.

question: 40 students me Ram upar se 12th hai. Neeche se uska sthan kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Neeche se sthan = Kul − Upar se sthan + 1 = 40 − 12 + 1 = 29th. | Galat kyun: A (30th) +1 bhoolne se banta hai; B (27th) aur D (28th) galat ghata hain. | Concept: Ranking me +1 isliye jodte hain kyunki vyakti khud bhi gina jata hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Kul − upar + 1 — '+1 mat bhoolo'. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B7.

question: 3 baje ghadi ki suiyon ke beech kitne degree ka kon banta hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — 3 baje ghante ki sui 3 par aur minute ki sui 12 par hoti hai — beech ka kon 90° (samkon) hota hai. | Galat kyun: A (120°) 4 baje ka kon hota hai; C (60°) 2 baje ka; D (180°) 6 baje ka. | Concept: Har ghanta = 30° (360° ÷ 12); 3 ghante = 90°. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Ghante × 30° — 3 × 30 = 90. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B7.

question: Kitab : Padhna :: Kalam : ?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Kitab padhne ke liye hoti hai, waise hi kalam likhne ke liye hota hai — vastu : uska upyog. | Galat kyun: A (kagaz) likhne ki jagah hai, kalam ka upyog nahi; B (syahi) kalam ke andar hoti hai; C (padhai) kitab se judi hai, kalam se nahi. | Concept: Analogy me sambandh pehchano — yahan 'vastu : kriya'. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Kitab→Padhna, Kalam→Likhna — kaam ka joda. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B5.

question: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Doctor hospital me kaam karta hai, waise hi teacher school me kaam karta hai — vyakti : karyasthal. | Galat kyun: A (class) school ka hissa hai, karyasthal nahi; B (student) teacher ka 'grahak' hai; C (book) teacher ka auzaar hai. | Concept: Analogy me sambandh pehchano — yahan 'vyakti : uska karyasthal'. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Doctor→Hospital, Teacher→School. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B5.

question: Visham (odd one out) chuniye: 2, 3, 5, 7, 9
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — 9 composite (abhajya nahi) hai: 9 = 3 × 3; baki 2, 3, 5, 7 sab prime hain. | Galat kyun: A (2) ekmatra sam prime hai — prime hi hai; B (7) aur C (3) bhi prime hain. | Concept: Prime = sirf 1 aur khud se vibhajya; composite = aur bhi gunankhand. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 9 = 3×3 — prime nahi. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B5.

question: Visham chuniye: Rose, Lotus, Marigold, Mango
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Mango phal hai; Rose, Lotus, Marigold teeno phool hain. | Galat kyun: B (Rose), C (Marigold), D (Lotus) sab phool hain — isiliye odd nahi. | Concept: Odd one out me pehle group ki pehchan karo, phir bahar wale ko chuno. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Phool-phool-phool-phal — phal alag. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B5.

question: 'Sabhi kutte janwar hain; sabhi janwar jeevit hain' se kya nishkarsh nikalta hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Venn se samjho: saare kutte janwar ke circle ke andar hain, aur saara janwar circle 'jeevit' ke andar hai — isliye saare kutte jeevit hain. | Galat kyun: A (koi kutta jeevit nahi) aur D (kuchh kutte jeevit nahi) ulta nishkarsh hain; C (kuchh janwar kutte nahi) kathn se nahi nikalta. | Concept: 'Sabhi A, B hain' + 'Sabhi B, C hain' → 'Sabhi A, C hain' (chain rule). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Circle ke andar circle — jo andar hai woh sab par lagu. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B6.

question: A ka vipreet (opposite) akshar kaun sa hai? (A=1...Z=26, yog 27)
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Vipreet akshar ka yog 27 hota hai: A(1) + Z(26) = 27, isliye A ka opposite Z hai. | Galat kyun: A (Y) B ka opposite hai (2+25=27); B (B) A ke paas hai; C (X) C ka opposite hai (3+24=27). | Concept: Opposite letters — A↔Z, B↔Y, C↔X… yog hamesha 27. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 27 ka joda — A+Z=27. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B1.

question: Uttar ki ore 5 km, phir dayein 3 km, phir dayein 4 km chalne par shuruaat se kitni doori hogi?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Rasta banao: Uttar 5 km → dayein (Purab) 3 km → dayein (Dakshin) 4 km. Uttar-dakshin me bacha: 5 − 4 = 1 km uttar; purab 3 km. Seedhi doori = √(1² + 3²) = √10 km (Uttar-Purab disha). | Galat kyun: A (5 km) sirf pehla kadam hai; B (3 km) sirf purab ki doori hai; C (√5 km) 1²+2² se banta hai — purab 2 nahi, 3 hai. | Concept: Disha me kul chali doori nahi, shuruaat se seedhi doori (Pythagoras) nikalte hain. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Rasta banao, phir Pythagoras — √10. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B4.

question: Delhi : Bharat :: Paris : ?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Delhi Bharat ki rajdhani hai, waise hi Paris France ki rajdhani hai — desh : rajdhani. | Galat kyun: B (Italy) aur C (Germany) desh hain, rajdhani nahi; D (London) Britain ki rajdhani hai, France ki nahi. | Concept: Analogy me sambandh pehchano — yahan 'desh : rajdhani'. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Delhi→Bharat, Paris→France. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B5.

question: Yadi 1 Jan 2026 Thursday hai, to 8 Jan 2026 kaun sa din hoga?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — 8 Jan, 1 Jan se 7 din baad hai; 7 din = poora ek hafta, isliye din wahi rahega — Thursday. | Galat kyun: A (Wednesday) ek din pehle hai; B (Friday) ek din baad hai; D (Saturday) do din baad hai. | Concept: 7 din baad wahi din aata hai — '7 ka niyam'. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: +7 din = wahi din. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B7.

question: Ghadi ki suiyan 12 ghante me kitni baar milti hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Ghadi ki suiyan 12 ghante me 11 baar milti hain (lagbhag har 1 ghanta 5.5 minute me ek baar). | Galat kyun: B (12 baar) aam galti hai — 12 baje wali mulaqat do baar nahi gini jati; C (10) aur D (24) galat hain. | Concept: Suiyan har ~65.5 minute me milti hain, isliye 12 ghante me 11 baar. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 12 ghante = 11 mulaqat — '12 nahi, 11'. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B7.

question: 'Each of the students ___ present' — sahi verb chuniye.
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — 'Each' singular hai, isliye singular verb 'is' aayega: 'Each of the students is present.' | Galat kyun: A (were), B (have), C (are) sab plural verbs hain — 'each' ke saath nahi aate. | Concept: 'Each/every' hamesha singular verb leta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Each = ek-ek — singular verb. | Source: Standard English grammar — 'Each' takes a singular verb (NCERT Class 10 English Grammar).

question: Statement: 'Sabhi A, B hain.' Isse kya nahi nikalta?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — 'Sabhi A, B hain' se sirf 'Sabhi B, A hain' nahi nikalta — ulta nishkarsh galat hai. question: 'Rajkumar' me kaun sa samas hai?

question: 'She has been reading since morning' — kaun sa tense hai?

question: 'Ram writes a letter' ka passive kya hai?
option_a: A letter is wrote by Ram
option_b: A letter has written by Ram
option_c: A letter was written by Ram
option_d: A letter is written by Ram
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Present Simple passive: Object + is/am/are + V3 → 'A letter is written by Ram.' | Galat kyun: 'is wrote' galat hai (V3 'written' chahiye, V2 nahi); 'has written' active perfect hai (passive nahi); 'was written' past ka passive hai (present nahi). | Concept: Active → Passive — be + past participle (V3). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Passive me hamesha V3 (written, eaten) aata hai. | Source: notes/13_general_english.md §13.2.

question: 'He said, I am busy' ka indirect kya hai?

option_c: He said that he will be busy
option_d: He said that he was busy
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Direct se Indirect me reporting verb past ('said') ho to andar ka Present Simple Past Simple me badalta hai: 'I am busy' → 'he was busy'. | Galat kyun: 'is busy' (tense nahi badla), 'has been busy' (perfect — galat badlav) aur 'will be busy' (future — galat) teeno galat hain. | Concept: Direct → Indirect — tense ek kadam peeche jata hai (Present → Past). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: said + present → was (past). | Source: notes/13_general_english.md §13.2.

explanation: Sahi: A — 'A person who admires himself excessively' = Narcissist (khud ki atyadhik prashansa karne wala). | Galat kyun: Egoist = swarthi / khud ke hit me jeene wala (excessive self-admiration nahi); Misanthropist = manavta se nafrat karne wala; Altruist = dusron ke liye jeene wala (bilkul ulta). | Concept: One-word substitution — paribhasha ka sabse sahi ek shabd. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Narcissist = Narcissus (Greek katha — khud ki chhavi se prem). | Source: notes/13_general_english.md §13.3.

question: 'One who knows everything' — one word kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — 'One who knows everything' = Omniscient (omni = sab, scient = janna). | Galat kyun: Omnipotent = sab kuchh kar sakne wala; Omnipresent = har jagah hone wala; Ambidextrous = dono hathon se kaam kar sakne wala. | Concept: One-word substitution — 'omni' (sab) + root. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: omni-scient (science = janna), omni-potent (power), omni-present (present = maujood). | Source: notes/13_general_english.md §13.3.

question: 'One who can use both hands' — one word kya hai?

question: Sahi article chuniye: ___ hour

explanation: Sahi: B — 'An hour' — 'hour' me 'h' silent hai, shabd 'our' (swar) se shuru hota hai, isliye An aata hai. | Galat kyun: 'A' tab aata hai jab shabd vyanjan dhvani se shuru ho; 'The' nishchit cheez ke liye hota hai; 'koi nahi' galat hai kyunki article chahiye. | Concept: Article awaaz (sound) par nirbhar karta hai, akshar par nahi. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Hour = 'our' jaisa sunai deta hai → An hour. | Source: notes/13_general_english.md §13.4.

question: Sahi article chuniye: ___ university

explanation: Sahi: C — 'A university' — 'university' me 'u' ki awaaz 'yu' (vyanjan jaisi) hai, isliye A aata hai, An nahi. | Galat kyun: 'An' tab aata hai jab shabd swar dhvani se shuru ho; 'The' nishchit ke liye hai; 'koi nahi' galat hai. | Concept: Article awaaz par nirbhar karta hai — 'u' hamesha swar nahi hota. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: University = 'yu-niversity' → A university; jaise 'a uniform', 'a European'. | Source: notes/13_general_english.md §13.4.

question: 'He has been ill ___ Monday' — sahi preposition?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — 'Since' = samay ka bindu (point of time — Monday, 2020, morning); 'He has been ill since Monday' — bimaari Monday se shuru hui. | Galat kyun: 'For' avadhi (duration — three days) ke liye hota hai; 'by' aur 'from' yahan sahi nahi hain ('from' ke saath present perfect continuous nahi banta). | Concept: Since = point of time; For = duration. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Since + Monday (ek din), For + three days (avadhi). | Source: notes/13_general_english.md §13.4.

question: 'He has been ill ___ three days' — sahi preposition?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — 'For' = avadhi (duration — three days); 'He has been ill for three days'. | Galat kyun: 'Since' samay ke bindu ke liye hota hai (since Monday), avadhi ke liye nahi; 'at' aur 'from' yahan galat hain. | Concept: Since = point of time; For = duration. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: For + three days (avadhi); Since + Monday (bindu). | Source: notes/13_general_english.md §13.4.

question: 'Happy' ka synonym kya hai?

explanation: Sahi: A — Happy ka synonym Joyful (khush) hai; Glad bhi sahi hota. | Galat kyun: Sad Happy ka antonym hai; Angry (gussa) aur Tired (thaka) ka Happy se koi sambandh nahi. | Concept: Synonym — samaan arth; antonym se confuse na hon. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Happy–Joyful–Glad (dost); Happy–Sad (dushman). | Source: notes/13_general_english.md §13.3.

question: 'Brave' ka antonym kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Brave ka antonym Cowardly (kayarpan) hai. | Galat kyun: Courageous aur Bold Brave ke synonym hain (antonym nahi); Strong (mazboot) ka Brave se seedha sambandh nahi. | Concept: Antonym — vipreet arth; synonym se confuse na hon. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Brave–Courageous (dost), Brave–Cowardly (dushman). | Source: notes/13_general_english.md §13.3.

question: 'Each of the students ___ present' — sahi verb?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — 'Each' hamesha singular hota hai, isliye singular verb 'is' aayega: 'Each of the students is present.' | Galat kyun: 'are', 'were' aur 'have' plural hain — 'students' plural dikhe to bhi subject 'Each' hai, 'students' nahi. | Concept: Subject-verb agreement — 'Each/Every/Neither' ke saath singular verb. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Each/Every/Neither → singular verb (is/was/has). | Source: notes/13_general_english.md §13.1.

question: 'She ate an apple' ka passive kya hai?
option_a: An apple has eaten by her
option_b: An apple is ate by her
option_c: An apple is eaten by her
option_d: An apple was eaten by her
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Past Simple passive: Object + was/were + V3 → 'An apple was eaten by her.' | Galat kyun: 'has eaten' active perfect hai; 'is ate' galat hai (V3 'eaten' chahiye aur past me 'was'); 'is eaten' present ka passive hai (past nahi). | Concept: Passive — tense wahi, be + V3. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Past passive = was + V3 (was eaten, was written). | Source: notes/13_general_english.md §13.2.

question: Passage: 'The camel is called the ship of the desert. It can walk for many days in the hot desert without water. It carries people and heavy loads across the sand.' — Camel ko 'ship of the desert' kyun kaha jata hai?
option_a: It carries people and loads across the desert
option_b: It can live without water for many days
option_c: It is the fastest animal in the desert
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Passage ke anusar camel desert me logon aur bojh ko le jata hai — jaise jahaz samudra me logon aur saaman ko le jata hai; yahi 'ship' wali tulna hai, isliye 'ship of the desert'. | Galat kyun: B (bina pani ke kai din reh sakta hai) passage me sahi hai, lekin yah 'ship' tulna ko nahi samjhata — jahaz ki tulna bojh le jane se hai, pani ke bina rehne se nahi; C (sabse tez) passage me nahi kaha gaya; D (sirf Rajasthan) galat hai — camel kai deserts me milta hai. | Concept: Comprehension — prashn ka uttar passage ki tulna (comparison) se milta hai, sirf sahi tathya se nahi. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Ship = le jane wala (carry) — camel desert ka jahaz hai kyunki vah bojh le jata hai. | Source: notes/13_general_english.md §13.5 (passage ke aadhar par).
